★ ★ ★Where the stars fall

All 19,720 restaurants in the MICHELIN Guide, placed on one map. Switch award levels and price tiers to see how distinction and price travel together, then ask a model which unstarred restaurants look most like starred ones.

    Star potential

    A model trained on price, location, cuisine and facilities gives every restaurant a probability of being starred. Unstarred restaurants with high scores look, on paper, like starred ones.

      Share of restaurants with a star, by price

      Star potential comes from a gradient-boosted model scored out-of-fold (ROC AUC 0.93, well calibrated); it describes resemblance, not a forecast. Price symbols are relative to each local market, so $$ in Tokyo and $$ in Bangkok are different amounts. Data: MICHELIN Guide Restaurants (Kaggle, Jerry Ng).
